subject.title: Feature: fallbackChannel for hook mappings when primary delivery fails

question: Should OpenClaw replay hook completion payloads across ordered explicit cross-channel destinations after the primary delivery attempt fails?
rationale: Current contracts intentionally separate primary completion delivery, additional completion webhooks, failure notifications, and source-context selection; cross-channel payload replay adds new public configuration, privacy, retry, and accounting semantics that require maintainer intent.

options.title: Shared explicit alternates
options.body: Add ordered explicit destination objects to the shared cron/hook delivery plan with validation, deduplication, attempt traces, and all-targets-failed reporting.

options.title: Failure notification only
options.body: Keep a single completion destination and use the existing separate failure destination to report the failed send without replaying the original payload.

options.title: No automatic failover
options.body: Retain explicit single-target delivery and require channel recovery or manual retry.

recommendation.title: Shared explicit alternates
recommendation.body: Add ordered explicit destination objects to the shared cron/hook delivery plan with validation, deduplication, attempt traces, and all-targets-failed reporting.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing issue review already frames the unresolved product choice across hook mapping, cron delivery, outbound sending, and documentation.
